newsitem.title: CHINA: China to sign up 15 mln new telephone users in '97.
newsitem.headline: China to sign up 15 mln new telephone users in '97.

text.p: China will sign up 15 million new telephone subscribers by the end of this year, when China's telephone availability rate will reach 7.4 percent, the Business News said on Monday.

China's investment in the posts and telecommunications sector will be accelerated, with investment in the industry's fixed assets hitting 95 billion yuan, the newspaper quoted Wu Jichuan, Minister of Posts and Telecommunications, as saying.
China's telephone switching capacity will increase by 17 million lines, and four million new mobile telephone clients will be added, he said.
